name: 360 Connect Hub
author: NET360

sections.description:
360 Connect Hub adds a customizable WhatsApp contact widget to your WordPress site and lets visitors choose an agent before starting a conversation.

360 Connect Hub includes unlimited WhatsApp agents, lead capture, lead export with date range filtering, statistics, country detection, avatar customization, color customization, button positioning, responsive design, and Spanish and English support.

360 Connect Hub is an independent NET360 project and is not affiliated with, sponsored by, or endorsed by WhatsApp or Meta Platforms, Inc.

Features

  • Unlimited WhatsApp agents.
  • Capture name, email, message, page, and selected agent.
  • Lead export to CSV with date range filtering.
  • Lead statistics.
  • Country detection when enabled.
  • Customizable avatar.
  • Customizable header color.
  • Configurable button position and spacing.
  • Responsive design for desktop and mobile.
  • Spanish and English support.

External Services

360 Connect Hub may use Cloudflare when the site is behind Cloudflare to obtain the country code provided in the HTTP_CF_IPCOUNTRY header.

When Cloudflare does not provide that value and country detection is enabled, the plugin may query FreeIPAPI over HTTPS to obtain the country code associated with the visitor IP address. The request contains the visitor IP address. Site owners should disclose this processing to visitors according to their applicable privacy obligations. FreeIPAPI states that its free service allows commercial use and applies rate limits.

Service: FreeIPAPI
Purpose: IP country detection
Website: https://freeipapi.com/
Terms: https://freeipapi.com/terms
Privacy: https://freeipapi.com/privacy

Privacy

When a visitor submits the widget, 360 Connect Hub stores the name, email address, selected agent, message, page URL, and country when available in the WordPress database.

Site administrators are responsible for configuring appropriate privacy notices and retention policies according to applicable law.

Development and Source Code

All custom PHP, JavaScript, CSS, and other source code used by this plugin is included in the plugin package. The plugin does not require a build step to regenerate its custom assets.
sections.installation:
1. Install and activate 360 Connect Hub from Plugins > Add New.
  2. Open 360 Connect Hub > Settings.
  3. Configure the company name, avatar, appearance, and agents.
  4. Save the settings.
  5. The widget will appear automatically on the frontend.
sections.faq:
How many WhatsApp agents are supported?

There is no fixed agent limit. You can configure as many WhatsApp agents as needed.

Can I export leads?

Yes. Leads can be filtered by date range and exported as CSV compatible with Excel.

Is 360 Connect Hub an official WhatsApp product?

No. 360 Connect Hub is an independent integration for WordPress websites.
sections.changelog:
1.2.0

  • Removed the fixed limit on WhatsApp agents.
  • Added lead export with date range filtering.

1.1.9

  • Updated the Tested up to header for current WordPress compatibility.

1.1.8

  • Renamed the plugin to 360 Connect Hub.
  • Updated internal identifiers to avoid conflicts with the previous 360 Chat installation.
  • Removed the frontend attribution link.
  • Removed bundled .po and .mo translation files.
  • Kept custom source assets in the distributed package.

1.1.6

  • Replaced ipapi.co with FreeIPAPI for country detection.
  • Updated external service documentation with FreeIPAPI terms and privacy information.
  • Updated plugin version metadata to 1.1.6.

1.1.5

  • Improved Plugin Check compatibility and escaping.
  • Reworked lead queries to use prepared identifier placeholders.
  • Removed the deprecated manual text-domain loading call.
  • Improved upgrade cleanup for old demo avatar data.
  • Updated readme metadata and English repository-facing documentation.
  • Added Plugin Check ignores for intentional reads and writes to the plugin database table.

1.1.2

  • Removed the colored outline around the floating button.
  • Added the heartbeat/pulse animation.
  • Kept hover subtle and without a colored border.

1.0.0

  • Initial release.
